shared_elements: registers or banded division of the surface
justification: A depicts a figural programme — rows of crouching quadrupeds along the top, a bird-headed/beaked creature, a small human-like figure, a snake and other animals arranged in stacked registers — while B is purely abstract, covered with dense hatched triangles, chevrons and lozenge networks with no creatures at all. The only overlap is the generic use of incised linear zigzag/hatched patterning and a loose banding of the surface, which any tradition could produce independently.
